items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And that was the year that Wardell Gray came up dead mysteriously.

ctx.x: Yes. A big band. And I missed that one because I was over at my grandmother's house. She had just had a stroke, and I was over there. No-one could find me. And that was the year that Wardell Gray came up dead mysteriously.
By the side of the road. He was working with Benny,
